title: Local record of managed engine installs (~/.clozn/engines/registry.json)
description: Written by clozn/setup/registry.py, atomically (clozn._io.atomic_write_json), on every successful `clozn setup`/`setup upgrade`/`setup rollback`. `active` and `previous` are install keys (see `installed`); `previous` is what `clozn setup rollback` restores, never deleted by an upgrade. A key absent from `installed` is a self-heal signal (its directory was removed out of band), not an error -- readers must treat it the same way clozn/cli/engine_process.py's daemons.json registry treats a dead pid: prune, don't crash.

active.description: The install key (see `installed`) clozn/cli/engine_process.py's managed-engine discovery tier resolves to. Absent when nothing has ever been successfully installed.

previous.description: The install key `clozn setup rollback` restores `active` to. Absent when there is nothing to roll back to (a fresh install, or after a rollback has already consumed it).

installed.description: install key -> installed-artifact record. Keys are '<version>/<os>-<arch>-<backend>[cuda_major]' (see clozn/setup/registry.py's install_key()).

sha256.description: sha256 of the downloaded archive, not the extracted entrypoint file -- this is what clozn.runs.identity_providers.engine_artifact reports as artifact_sha256.

entrypoint.description: Absolute path to the extracted clozn-server executable.
